name: Razor Reflex / resolution lifecycle / nuu-foreign-owner-clear
notes: This is a mid-turn fixture after Nuu paid its Chi cost and its Instant ability resolved targeting player2. A player2-owned blue Razor is publicly banished; the exact native MST_NUU permission state is present. Nuu may play it this turn without paying its resource cost. Play a Generic cost0 attack, then play the foreign-owned blue Razor through the existing permission and ordinary action runner. On Stack Owner2 and Controller1 must differ. The attack gets+1; after resolution Razor goes to player2 graveyard, never player1. Stop before hit so this ownership test does not depend on the separate pending Razor on-hit trigger fix.
